description: This file defines the CosmosReminderTable class, which implements the IReminderTable interface for managing reminders stored in Azure Cosmos DB. It includes methods for initializing the database, reading, upserting, and removing reminder entries, as well as handling Cosmos DB client setup and error logging.

classes.name: CosmosReminderTable
classes.description: A class that manages reminder entries in Azure Cosmos DB, providing methods for initialization, CRUD operations, and resource management, with detailed logging and error handling.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Cosmos DB client, creates resources if enabled, and sets up the container for reminders.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a specified range of hash values.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry by grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry by grain ID and reminder name, considering the ETag for concurrency.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all reminder entries from the table, used for testing purposes.

methods.name: InitializeCosmosClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes the Cosmos DB client.

methods.name: TryDeleteDatabase
methods.description: Attempts to delete the Cosmos DB database if it exists.

methods.name: TryCreateCosmosResources
methods.description: Creates the Cosmos DB database and container with specified indexing policies.

methods.name: FromEntity
methods.description: Converts a ReminderEntity to a ReminderEntry.

methods.name: ToEntity
methods.description: Converts a ReminderEntry to a ReminderEntity for storage.
